changed_reading.before: Children who become pubescent should ask permission as older people do.
changed_reading.after: Puberty is a status crossing by which a former child enters the precedent-bearing class responsible for initiating authorization.

baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated form of the permission root can combine announcement, being heard, knowledge, and license: the entrant makes a boundary crossing explicit and awaits recognition rather than moving on an unspoken assumption.

baseline_models.mechanism: The inventory lets the explicit puberty sense of حلم resonate with composed self-restraint, while بيان separates and marks and حكم restrains for repair; the rule can therefore install an internal gate at maturity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, those not yet at puberty circulate through the household and request permission at three named exposure intervals. The focus repeats the threshold and permission roots but omits the interval list, changing a punctuated child schedule into the broader practice of the preceding class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, entry into a house and departure from a collective affair require an overt request that can receive a real answer; returning when refused is honored, while slipping away under cover is the negative image. The focus inducts the maturing child into this general grammar of visible boundary crossing.

It remains anchored in كَمَا ... ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ and is activated by two whole-surah predecessor formulas; downstream prose should present prior generations as a historical resonance, not disambiguate the phrase away from the immediate cohort.

strongest_changes: 24:58 makes 24:59 a switch from three exposure-timed gates for circulating children to the broader permission discipline of maturity.
24:31 makes puberty legible as a proxy for privacy awareness and gaze accountability, not age alone.
24:27-28 and 24:62-63 expand permission into a general practice of visible, answerable boundary crossing.
24:54 reactivates developmental reaching as entry into communicative accountability.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a two-scale design: daily thresholds of exposure become a lifecycle threshold of responsibility, while the same permission root coordinates household entry, collective departure, and explicit communication. The child root's uninvited-entry and twilight branches preserve two useful but contained counter-images.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether those before them primarily means the immediately older permission-seekers or also resonates with prior generations.
Whether puberty is only the operative bodily criterion or also intentionally proxies individual awareness and self-restraint.
Whether the communication and epistemic patterns are designed cross-domain mechanisms or strong lexical-structural resonances.
